g.text: ShipSafe // The Pre-Flight Ghostbuster for Production Traps
Catches spooky database table locks, phantom secrets & zombie loops before code ships
Halts async db queries in loops & sync I/O
Production crash prevented before commit leaves laptop
Zero table locks · Zero 3 AM pages
[STYLE: Ian Bablu 16:9 Landscape | Pure White #FFFFFF | Hand-Drawn Ink Linework | Halloween Hack Edition | Bablu IP © TRioN]
Architecture: Local Git Hook Buffer → AST Multi-Stage Hazard Sentry → Gemma 2 Pre-Mortem → Quarantine or Verified Release.
